record.notes: compute/emergent-ventures is a different entity: a grant fund, not this app builder. The two must not be merged on the shared word. A third-party review site states the free tier is 10 credits a month and calls it "Free forever"; the vendor page says first day. The conflict is recorded rather than resolved, because the vendor page is the stronger source and it does not say monthly.
